verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents its own pre-request and after-response scripts. These run automatically at request-lifecycle events and can change environment variables, auth, or request contents, which amounts to narrow event-triggered logic. There is no general rules engine or event-trigger system, and CI-based automation through Inso CLI depends on external Git/CI workflows rather than product-native triggers. Missing for 10: a general rule/trigger definition system, events beyond request send/response (e.g. schedules, spec changes, sync events), and hands-on corroboration.
